summary: Tested the visit templates v2 rollout (backend and frontend). Backend: 29/29 pass, 1 skipped (TTS chunk missing after a container restart). This run used the new tests/test_visit_templates_v2.py, the rewritten test_live_checklist.py (checklist_id='template' + template_id) and the seed tests in test_bilanci/test_visit_templates with updated counts. An earlier full run of the real-chunk test against the 6-month template (bilancio 6m) passed. Checks run against medico@mantmed.it: 'Nuovo modello' is gone. Prima visita has 17 fields (Motivo della visita* first; Diagnosi/Valutazione*, Terapia, Indicazioni ai genitori* last; 'Peso e altezza con percentili' in Parametri vitali). Malattia acuta 17/5, Controllo 9/4, Certificato sportivo non agonistico 8/5, each with its kind. pending_fields: 6 on the 1m-18m bilanci, 3 on the older ones (5-6a has none because it was never modified and was auto-updated). /bilanci library: growth fields come right after anamnesi in 1m-18m, the 3 end fields are on all bilanci, required flags are correct. /base?kind returns the right fields. Required flag persists. The pending add/ignore endpoint works (422 and 404 handled). upgrade_once was simulated on the cardio account: an untouched 'Nuovo modello' identical to Prima visita is deleted, a modified one is kept, and the Extra models (Malattia acuta, Controllo, Certificato) are not duplicated. Cardio has the 3 new models. UI: Obbligatorio switches work (toggle, Salva, reload persists, restored afterwards). The pending notice on 6 mesi lists 6 chips with *; 'Aggiungi i nuovi campi' appends them at the end (prefix unchanged, 10->16) and the notice disappears. 'Ignora' on 9 mesi hides the notice and leaves the fields unchanged; both persist after reload. 'Ripristina modello base' on Malattia acuta loads 17 fields. Overlay setup (clock fixed at 10:00): Francesco Bruno -> 'Bilancio di salute · 6 mesi'. 'Cambia' opens the picker, picking Controllo updates the name and closes it. Free name -> Prima visita. Waiting reason 'Febbre…' -> Malattia acuta, 'Ricontrollo otite' -> Controllo, 'Certificato sportivo' -> Certificato. Recording in demo mode: the checklist uses the template fields with sections by group and '*' on required. live-model-picker lists all 14 templates. Termina -> live-missing-dialog lists the 5 required labels. 'Termina comunque' gives a note in status ready with sezioni in template order, fonte=ai on the 2 ticked fields and 'Non rilevato' on the rest. Demo was turned OFF afterwards (verified via API). The mobile layout (390) of the setup model row and the template editor is fine.

minor.issue: templates_v is set to 2 BEFORE the upgrade runs. If an exception happens midway (e.g. an LLM call in base_fields for a non-library specialty, or a DB error), the upgrade is never retried for that doctor. Set the version after the work, or make each step idempotent and retry.

Malattia acuta, Controllo and Certificato sportivo are added to every doctor, as the user asked. Their content is pediatric, though: the cardiologist's Malattia acuta contains 'Segni di allarme spiegati ai genitori'. Consider neutral wording for non-pediatric specialties, or confirm this is intended.
Legacy fixed checklist models are now dead code (start forces checklist_id='template'), and api.checklists is still in frontend/src/lib/api.js. Remove them to avoid confusion.
The visit_template_bases cache rebuild drops the 'required' key. This is harmless today but inconsistent.

ui_bugs.issue: Boundary tie: a month equal to one bilancio's exclusive age_to gets distance 0 for both neighbours, and reduce keeps the first. So 'Bilancio di salute del 2° mese' picks '1° mese' instead of '3 mesi' (2 is inside 3m's range [2,4.5)), and 21 months picks 18m instead of 2-3a. Prefer the in-range bilancio (dist 0 only when age_from <= m < age_to; otherwise compute the distance from the boundaries with a small epsilon, or check in-range first).

'Dolori addominali ricorrenti' (seeded agenda) -> Prima visita, because the regex has 'dolore' but not 'dolori'. A reason containing 'bilancio' with no age and no birth date falls through to Prima visita instead of a bilancio. Consider /dolor/ and a sensible bilancio fallback.

'+ Nuovo modello' still creates a template named 'Nuovo modello' with the base Prima visita fields (POST without fields -> base_fields). This recreates the exact duplicate the user asked to delete. Consider creating it empty or asking for a name.

design_issues.screen: Live checklist after 'Aggiungi i nuovi campi'
issues: Sections are ordered by first appearance. Growth fields appended at the end (as the rule requires) make 'PARAMETRI VITALI' the last section, after 'ACCERTAMENTI E ALTRO'. Consider ordering sections by the canonical group order in the checklist.

The pending-fields notice is only visible after selecting each template. There is no badge or dot on the pills or the section header showing which templates have new fields available, so the doctor can easily miss them.

action_items: Fix the autoTemplate boundary tie: 'Bilancio … 2° mese' should pick 3 mesi; the in-range bilancio must win.
Optional: widen the acuta regex (dolori), and add a bilancio fallback when the reason says 'bilancio' but has no age and no birth date.
Set templates_v after upgrade_once completes, so a failed upgrade can be retried.
Decide whether '+ Nuovo modello' should create an empty template rather than a Prima visita clone.
Remove the dead /api/checklists + CHECKLISTS code and api.checklists.
Optional UX: order checklist sections canonically; show a pending-fields badge on the template pills.
critical_code_review_comments: visit_templates.py upgrade_once: version flag is set before the work (not retry-safe). Pending detection compares titles only; a renamed field is re-proposed, which is acceptable.
useLiveChecklist.autoTemplate: dist() treats age_to as inclusive, which causes ties at shared boundaries.

ConsultationOverlay: once the doctor picks a model manually (userPicked), changing the patient no longer re-runs autoTemplate for the rest of the overlay session. This is intended ('finché il medico non lo cambia') but could surprise users who switch patient after picking.
server.py start_consultation (pre-existing): appointments.update_many by patient_name marks ALL same-name appointments completato. Prefer the appointment_id.

test_bilanci.py TestDeleteReimport and test_edit_preserved_after_reimport are destructive on the real medico account (delete + reimport bilanci, which loses ids, modifications and pending_fields). Rewrite them against a TEST_ template or a dedicated test doctor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 medium + 2 low logic issues

rca of the issue: Original bug ('modifiche non applicate'): the existing templates were stored per doctor and never re-seeded. The v2 upgrade_once fixes this: it updates untouched templates, proposes pending_fields on modified ones and inserts the new models. Verified working.
